utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting again this week. What are they reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: They’re reading a new mystery novel this week. It should give us something to talk about.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, a mystery sounds like good book club material. I’ll have to see if I can make it this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in for the book club. Just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll text you the time and place shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just text me when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the book club meets on Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Thursday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Thursday is still the plan?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club. I might have left the sign-up sheet somewhere, but I’d be happy to join if you still have room.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, there’s room. If you find the sheet, bring it by and I’ll mark you in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out for it and bring it by if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which day the book club meets? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s on Thursday evening, if I’m remembering right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — Thursday evening sounds right to me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the part where you picked the next book?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet — I was just about to suggest it. We can still pick one together if you want to weigh in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’d love to help pick it — what are you considering?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus. I can help with the book club if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Sam. I can bring a few spare copies and help set up the meeting space.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Gus. I can help welcome everyone and make sure things run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets near the library, right? I can check the exact room if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, near the library sounds right. If you can check the exact room, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the exact room and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s meeting again this week, and I heard they’re picking something a little lighter this time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, nice, that sounds like my kind of meeting. If you want, I can bring a few lighter picks to suggest too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect, bring them along and we’ll have a few options to compare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we meeting at the library for book club or somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we said the library. I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, see you at the library.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard the book club is meeting next week, and I’ll pass that along to Nell.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, please let me know what time next week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’ve got the book club notes ready, so we can keep it simple and pick a date that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good. I can make it if we keep it on a weekday evening.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, then I’ll set it for a weekday evening and send around a couple of options.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club is meeting at Marcy's place this week, and she picked a mystery novel that's apparently a real page-turner.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A mystery should keep us busy. I’ll bring a notebook and be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you’re going to fit right in then. I’ll tell Marcy to save you a good seat.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, hey, I’m a little late, but I’m in. What are we reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re doing The Left Hand of Darkness this month. I can send you the meeting time after this.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I’m looking forward to it. Send me the time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much about it yet, but I’d be glad to listen. What’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s a quiet one this month, just a short novel I thought might be easy to talk about.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good pace for the group. What made you choose it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, book club tonight? I can make it if that’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on. I’ll be at the library at 7.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll see you at the library at 7.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the book club’s picking up again, Hana. Are you thinking of joining this round?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I might, but I’d want to know when it’s meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It meets next Tuesday evening at the community center, if that helps you decide.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, book club. Is that tonight or did it already happen?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s tonight, unless I mixed up the time. I can check the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please check it. I don’t want to show up late again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club’s meeting moved to Thursday, so I’m swinging by the library after errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend you my folding cart if you need it for the library run.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d make the library run easier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be glad to join, Leo. What book are you all reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good to me. I’m looking forward to hearing what you picked.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make it, but I’d need the time and place a bit ahead of time so I can plan the bus and the books.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure - I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — that would help a lot. Just send me the time and place when you know them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Cleo - our book club's meeting this week, and I'd love for you to come.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d love to come. What book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re reading The Night Circus this week - it’s a great one, and I think you’ll enjoy the discussion.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can probably make the book club, but I need to work around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can work around that. What time does the pickup usually wrap up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Usually around 3:15, sometimes a little later if the line is long.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell — I can help get the book club organized. What date were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I was thinking maybe next Thursday, if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds good to me, Nell. Let’s see if next Thursday works for the others, and I’ll help coordinate it.
